# ui::CollectionChange

Header: `winui/core/ObservableVector.hpp`.

One change of a [ui::ObservableVector](observable-vector.md), delivered to its observers after the collection has already changed.

| Field | Type | Default | |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `CollectionChangeKind` | `CollectionChangeKind::Reset` | What happened. |
| `index` | `std::size_t` | `0` | Where it happened; unused for a Reset. |
| `count` | `std::size_t` | `0` | How many items it covers; 1 for a move. |
| `to` | `std::size_t` | `0` | For a move, the item's new position. |
| `size` | `std::size_t` | `0` | The collection's size after the change. |
